src=open('tmp/t_request.py').read()
src=src.replace("""print('request tests done, failures:',len(fails))""",
"""# rerouting: the cheapest offer is contested and one request has no alternative
rows=[icmp('a',N1+'1'),icmp('b',N1+'2',probe='0/i2')]
job=campaign(rows,
             [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2')],
             [offer('A',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2')),
              offer('B',capacity=1,cost=5,requests=('r1',))],rq=9,og=9)
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('rerouting',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(2,6))
check('rerouting choices',sorted((a['request'],a['offer']) for a in out['plan']['assignments']),
      [('r1','B'),('r2','A')])
# deeper rerouting chain
job=campaign(rows,
             [request('r1'),request('r2',target=N1+'2'),request('r3',target=N1+'3')],
             [offer('A',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('B',capacity=1,cost=2,requests=('r1','r2')),
              offer('C',capacity=1,cost=9,requests=('r1',))],rq=9,og=9)
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('chain',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(3,12))

print('request tests done, failures:',len(fails))""")
open('tmp/t_request.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/t_request.py
